scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,electron -c green,magenta -k "npm run dev -w client" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm run dev -w electron"
scripts.package:linux: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client && npm run package:linux -w electron
scripts.package:win: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client && npm run package:win -w electron
